The '''Tommaba Brotherhood''' was a scout organization comprised of natives of the destroyed [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was named after a wandering herd animal that lived on the plains of Alderaan. Membership of the Tommaba Brotherhood was restricted to native [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]].<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
